x25519.evidence: published. No independent implementation was run here, so this is the recalled RFC value checked against x25519-dalek only - two sources, one of which is the code under test. The test computes the agreement in both directions and derives each public key from its private key, so a wrong value fails rather than passing.

argon2id.evidence: published. No independent implementation was available here (argon2-cffi is not installed), so this is the recalled RFC value checked against the argon2 crate only - two sources, one of which is the code under test. Weaker than the HKDF and ChaCha entries, and labelled so in the test.
argon2id.note: m = 32 KiB is below this project's I4 floor, so the test builds the primitive directly rather than through derive::KdfParams, which refuses it.
